items.description: Un corbeau aux reflets de graphite veille sur un col noyé de brume.
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one exquisite collectible creature card illustration for Nosfy, full-bleed vertical 2:3 portrait, ideally 1024x1536. World: LES CIMES ÉTEINTES / THE DARKENED PEAKS.
Art direction: a dark, poetic alpine universe of huge black mountains, deep valleys of charcoal fog, fractured volcanic slate, tiny traces of old snow. No sea. A night so ancient that the rock feels alive. Beautiful and emotionally compelling creatures, never grotesque. Premium highly resolved fine-art dark-fantasy naturalism, tactile detailed materials with painterly atmospheric depth, believable anatomy, elegant silhouette immediately legible at phone thumbnail size. This is meticulously authored collectible art, not a generic game screenshot, not a flat animal photograph.
Palette and lighting: obsidian black, smoke gray, weathered silver, cold pearl, a very restrained burnt-amber glint as the shared ember signature. Almost monochromatic but with rich midtones: dark must remain readable, not crushed. A narrow clean waning crescent distant in the sky, subtle, not an emblem. Beautiful silver rim light separates the creature from layered dark mountains. The illustration extends edge to edge.
Composition: one single complete artwork, never a grid or mockup. Main face and identifying features in the central 75 percent of image width; no vital feature clipped. Leave a little atmospheric breathing room at top and bottom for the app's existing card frame. Creature and mountain landscape both unmistakable.
No lettering, no typography, no card name, no logos, no watermarks, no frame, no border, no rarity symbols, no decorative user interface. No marine creatures, no ocean, no dragons, no bright fairy colors, no neon, no runes, no armor, no equipment, no ornamental clutter, no gore.
Card 1 — COMMON: LE GUETTEUR / THE LOOKOUT. The common card must be as carefully finished and beautiful as the legendary; its beauty is intimate rather than gigantic.
Subject and scene: a single magnificent mountain raven perched in three-quarter view on the broken lip of a wet black-slate ridge, looking back toward the viewer, head alert and expressive, a subtly asymmetric silver feather beside one eye as its recognizable signature. Its claws hold the stone naturally. Entire bird and tail visible, filling about half the image height; a quiet emotionally arresting close encounter. Behind it, vertiginous dark crags, a narrow mountain pass disappearing into layers of low mist, sparse frosty alpine grass in the foreground.
Details: exquisitely articulated overlapping black feathers, matte velvet chest against lightly polished graphite wing coverts, tiny droplets and frost only along some feather edges, fine beak scratches, a small warm amber catchlight in a living dark eye. Wet slate has silver strata, minute lichen and glasslike beads of melting frost. A few drifting snow grains catch moonlight. The raven's feather surfaces suggest smoky mother-of-pearl only where light grazes them; no magical glow. One quiet triangular composition, rich cinematic separation, haunting calm, luxurious microdetail without visual noise. All parts anatomically credible.

items.description: Un lynx noir porte dans son pelage les lignes d’argent de la montagne.

Card 2 — RARE: LA VEILLEUSE / THE NIGHTWATCHER. Lavish detail and unmistakable creature identity, elevated material beauty.
Subject and scene: one breathtaking black alpine lynx pauses across a narrow fractured obsidian ledge, body at three-quarter profile, head turned toward viewer with calm intelligent silvery eyes. Full animal, four coherent legs, short tail and high pointed ears with long tapering tufts visible. Creature fills roughly 60 percent of image height. Its signature is a fine naturally grown crescent-shaped silver cheek marking on one side and a ruff whose long charcoal hairs have pearlescent silver tips, framing a beautiful serious face. Beyond the ledge, staggering black peaks emerge from fog and a dim starless sky.
Details: thousands of fine fur strands clump softly from cold mountain mist; a smoke-black spotted rosette pattern appears only where silver light grazes the coat; frost crystals on the ear tufts and whiskers; pads and claws subtly articulated. Across shoulder fur, a few hair-thin cold nacre highlights give a restrained precious shiny-like finish, silvery rather than rainbow. Small pools in slate reflect the crescent and a nearly hidden ember-color rock vein. Grounded believable weight, tension in the forward paw, lush detail in eyes and face, sharp readable silhouette, mountains softened by depth. Sacred wilderness, utterly dark and poetic, neither cute cartoon nor angry monster.

Card 3 — EPIC: LA TRAVERSÉE / THE CROSSING. Extraordinary scale and motion, still a creature with credible anatomy, rich fine detail.
Subject and scene: a magnificent immense black bearded vulture, a mythic dark lammergeier with a distinctive narrow beard and pale silver eyes, banks through a towering chasm between two sheer basalt mountain walls. View from slightly below and ahead. Wings sweep upward in a high open V to fit the portrait fully: BOTH entire wingtips and the long tapered diamond tail are visible with generous space inside the edges, no cropping. Face remains central and readable; dark body and wings separated from the silver fog behind. The bird fills around two-thirds of image height.
Details: layered long flight feathers of lacquered charcoal with subtle silver graphite rims, very fine cold pearl streaks in a few inner feathers, a restrained ember-russet throat patch echoing the universe's braise signature. Air flexes individually rendered feather tips, a thin veil of powdered snow spirals in its wake, each feather attached in coherent anatomy. Vast geological columns below, hanging shreds of mist and glacial striations make the wingspan feel monumental without extra animals or buildings. Crescent glimpsed high in a cleft. Controlled cinematic spectacle, luxurious microdetail on head and wing coverts, elegantly dark negative space, almost audible silence and wind, no fire effects.

Card 4 — LEGENDARY: LE ROI SANS AUBE / THE DAWNLESS KING. The absolute masterpiece of this set: ancient, sovereign, impossibly beautiful, breathtaking material richness and commanding presence. Escalate exquisite craftsmanship, silhouette, light and geological storytelling, not decorative objects.
Subject and scene: one monumental black alpine ibex stands on a narrow summit of shattered wet obsidian above a limitless abyss of fog. Slightly low viewpoint, dignified three-quarter stance with face turned almost toward viewer. Long heavy beard, expressive dark eyes with tiny warm amber reflections, broad chest, four powerful coherent legs and delicately cloven hooves. The unmistakable silhouette is a pair of enormous backward-curving saber horns with deep ancient growth ridges, high but fully visible with generous clearance to the top and sides. Horns are natural ibex horns transmuted into layered black obsidian, not deer antlers, not branches.
Legendary material treatment: every horn ridge carries translucent smoke-glass depth, microscopic silver mineral inclusions, soft pearlescent inner reflections, tiny polished chips and hair-thin amber fissures only deep in the obsidian. Highlights run along the outer curve like a restrained silver corona, never blazing neon. Jet-black fur is extraordinarily tactile, long chest strands dusted with sparse frost and catching platinum rimlight, subtle smoky nacre along shoulders, crystalline droplets on whiskers. His face must be noble, alive and moving, not monstrous. Deeply detailed ancient horn strata suggest the mountain's own history.
Landscape: black serrated peaks recede through many layers of charcoal storm cloud and silver fog, fine snow lines caught in rock crevices, a distant sliver of moonlight opens through the sky. The summit beneath him contains mirrored black stone facets and just two or three warm mineral pinpricks, no lava. Strong majestic vertical composition, legendary scale, lush but disciplined midtones, silver and black rather than bright white. Subject occupies about two-thirds of image height with horns and hooves safely away from edges. No throne, jewelry, armor, crown, runes or manufactured ornament. This should feel like discovering an ancient living secret of the mountain.
